title: Model ML Partners with Daloopa to Bring Audit-Linked Financial Data into the Platform - Model ML
summary: Model ML partners with Daloopa, bringing audit-linked financial data into the platform with fundamentals tied back to source filings.
body_markdown:
Daloopa is a financial data platform built for analysts who need speed without sacrificing accuracy. Using AI, Daloopa extracts standardized fundamental data from SEC filings, press releases, and investor presentations across 6,000+ companies globally – with each data point linked back to its original source document, so users can verify a number in seconds instead of digging back through a filing themselves.


"We’re very excited to announce this partnership, bringing Daloopa’s fundamental datasets directly into Model ML," said Chaz Englander, CEO of Model ML. "Our users can now tap into Daloopa's coverage across 6,000+ companies natively within the Model ML platform. Partnerships like this are exactly what we're focused on: giving our users access to the best data and tools, all in one place."


Thomas Li, CEO of Daloopa, said: "We're excited to partner with Model ML to bring Daloopa's audit-ready financial data directly into how financial and professional services teams build pitch decks, diligence reports, and investment memos. Model ML has built a strong platform for turning that work around fast, and together we're making sure the numbers underneath it are ones teams can trust."


Through MCP, Model ML users can access Daloopa's data directly in the Model ML platform, letting them build and update models faster with verified data, without leaving their workflow to cross-check numbers.


Available today for anyone with an active Daloopa license.
